_about: The reading record behind datalake/qif-anatomy-technique-regions.json. AI-drafted and unreviewed. For each registrar technique with a neural band: the words its own registrar text uses for a structure it acts on, reads from or is delivered through (links), or the reason none could be drafted (band_level), plus every mention that was read and not linked (skipped). `field` is a JSON Pointer relative to the technique. Edit this file, then run `node datalake/scripts/draft-technique-regions.mjs`; never edit the data file by hand.
_rules: A link's term is the catalog's word exactly as written, and its quote is copied from the named field. Nothing is added because a technique would plausibly affect a structure.

tara.dsm5.pathway text generated by build_pathway() in populate-dsm5.py names a band's example structures, not this technique's target. A structure named only there is not linked. A pathway string written for one technique is that technique's own text and is linked.

Where the text names a part (M1_larynx, anterior_insula, ventral striatum) or a wider structure (motor cortex, visual cortex) the term is kept as written even though it resolves to nothing; it is never shortened to a word that would resolve.

Extent: where one structure is written two ways with the same extent (M1 and primary_motor_cortex; PFC and prefrontal; hippocampus and hippocampal) one link is kept, the noun if there is one. Where two nouns name different extents (motor cortex and primary_motor_cortex) both are kept.

Adjectives: an adjective (hippocampal, prefrontal, thalamic, spinal) is linked when the text presents its structure as acted on, read from or passed through and no noun for that structure is linked. The bare adjective 'cortical' is linked only when the technique's text names no cortical structure by noun; where a cortical area is named (M1, SMA, motor cortex, V1, temporal cortex, cortex), 'cortical' is that target in looser words and is not a second extent.

Functional systems, networks and cell populations (reward network, default mode network, mirror neuron system, autonomic nervous system, motor neurons) are linked only when they are the value of a tara.engineering.parameters target field or a stage in the technique's own pathway string. In any other prose (limbic system, vestibular system, dopaminergic neurons, interneurons, astrocytes) they are skipped.

Organs: a sensory end-organ where transduction happens is linked (retina, cochlea, vestibule, vestibular organ). A gross organ or an electrode or stimulus site is not (eyes, ear canal, mastoid process, cymba conchae, skin). A device name is not (cochlear implant, retinal prosthesis).

Not linked, and recorded as skipped: negations, another technique's target named for contrast, the clinical analog's own target or condition, citations, and sites where a method was demonstrated in earlier work.

Band level: 'no_structure_named' when no field names a structure; 'structure_named_only_as_context' when one is named only in a skipped mention or in a list field that cannot be quoted; 'only_whole_structures_named' when the text points at a zone with no nameable structure; 'text_contradicts_band_tags' when the text says there is no neural pathway.
A link's rationale opens with its role: 'Named as ...', 'Adjective for ...' or 'The catalog's own target field.' No rationale or note may claim review, confirmation or expertise.
